card.title: PB4Y-2 PRIVATEER
card.text: It costs the enemy +2 kredits to target or attack this unit.
card.flavorText: The Consolidated PB4Y-2 Privateer was an American patrol bomber that was introduced in 1943 and used by the US Navy during WWII. The Privateer flew its first missions in 1944 in the Pacific Theater and took on a variety of roles such as reconnaissance, search and rescue, anti-shipping, electronic countermeasures and communication relay. The aircraft looked very similar to the B-24 Liberator, except that it had a single vertical tail which increased its stability in low and medium altitudes. The Privateer was designed for a crew of 11, including a pilot and co-pilot, navigator, bombardier, five gunners and two radio operators. Its armament included 12 M2 Browning machine guns and it could carry up to 5800 kg of bombs, mines, or torpedoes. A total of 739 Privateers were built, including variants, some of which were produced after the war.
